objective: Kill 7 Helboar in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

description: You are a <class>, no doubt.  I would ask an honorable task of you, but I must test your strength.
It is said that Rexxar would measure the sharpness of his blades by killing a helboar with a single, swift strike.  Now I will measure your strength by killing them.
progress: The burning spines of the helboar leave horrific scars. Do not fear the pain and disfigurement, warrior, they are nothing compared to the prison to which I am bound.
completion: I need no proof to know what you have done, warrior.  I can see the determination etched in your expression.
